info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Decisioning API
info.description: The Loan Application Decisioning API facilitates the submission of loan applications for assessment by the system. It allows users to initiate the decision-making process for specific loan applications identified by a unique parameter. Financial institutions and lending organizations typically use this API to automate decisions related to credit approvals and pricing. By integrating this service, businesses can enhance their lending workflows, ensuring quicker responses to applicants while maintaining compliance with internal policies.

post.summary: Create a decision for a specific loan application.
post.description: This endpoint allows authorized users to submit a decision for the loan application identified by RES-100045. The decision should reflect the outcome based on the assessment of the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a decision for a loan application identified by 'RES-100045'. It requires data in JSON format that specifies the decision details, including approval status and any related comments or requirements.

201.description: Successfully created a new decision for the loan application.
